en-US.description:
Cooler is a native companion for your Coolify instances. Check on your servers, restart services, follow deployments and read logs, right from your iPhone.

AT A GLANCE
• See every server and resource with its live status
• A health summary flags anything that needs your attention

RESOURCES
• Start, stop and restart applications, databases and services
• Follow logs as they come in

DEPLOYMENTS
• Browse deployment history and watch deployments in progress
• Cancel, redeploy or roll back in a couple of taps

NOTIFICATIONS
• Alerts for deployments, backups, scheduled tasks and servers
• Quiet hours, so alerts wait until you're ready
• Real-time push notifications through CoolerBridge, an open source service you host next to Coolify, linked with a CoolerCloud account

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Lock the app with Face ID
• Protected actions ask before anything risky runs
• Hide sensitive values, or flip or shake your phone to hide them instantly
• Your Coolify API token stays on your device, in the iOS Keychain

TRY IT FIRST
No Coolify instance yet? Start the built-in demo to explore everything Cooler can do.

Cooler is open source. Connecting your own instance needs Coolify and an API token.

Cooler is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Coolify.
en-US.promoText: Because self-hosting from your phone shouldn't feel like wrestling a desktop web dashboard.
en-US.title: Cooler for Coolify
en-US.subtitle: Coolify, in your pocket.
